tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of the app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, lesson tiles, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, progress tracks, wells inside cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative only).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: Raisin Black #2A292C in light. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, durations, hints. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Chrysler Blue #3F09C9 (lightened in dark so it stays legible). Primary actions, links, active lesson, focus ring; as text on surface, surface-raised and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected nav item, current stage, info callouts. Text on it is primary or ink.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Lime #B6FF00, the Learn colour. Wins and completion: finished lessons, progress fill, celebration moments. Fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lime fill.

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as text or icon ("Completed", success messages) on surface, surface-raised and lime-soft.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind lime-ink: win callouts, praise in code review.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Coral #F44446, the Evolve colour. Streaks, highlights and attention moments (new, due soon). Fill only; text on it is on-coral.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Large text (24px+ or bold 19px+) and icons on a coral fill, as on the brand book's coral logo page. Smaller text never sits on coral.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text or icon, on surface, surface-raised and coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind coral-ink: tips, should-fix review notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and must-fix review notes. Darker than coral and always paired with an icon and a word, so it never reads as a brand accent. On surface, surface-raised and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Cautions (deadline close, unsaved work); always with an icon and a word. On surface, surface-raised and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Chrysler Blue at full value in both themes, for brand bands: onboarding hero, stage intros, the certificate, the app icon. Text and the white logo on it use on-raisin.

tokens.name: raisin
tokens.usage: Deep brand band: hero headers, the cover, certificate frames. Text on it is on-raisin.

tokens.name: on-raisin
tokens.usage: Text and the white logo on a raisin or brand-blue band.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring in primary, 2px outside the element.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; underlined at rest.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, certificate, stage intros.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Learn one idea at a time, then build with it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Submit your project by Friday, 23:59 WAT.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related items in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above major section titles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, lesson tiles, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress bars, avatars, stage nodes.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, dialogs.
